CREATE TABLE "public"."Category" (
  "color" text NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "icon" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."FixedExpense" (
  "active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "dueDay" int4 NOT NULL,
  "estimatedAmount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "subcategoryId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Subcategory" (
  "categoryId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "icon" text NOT NULL,
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Transaction" (
  "amount" numeric NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "dueDate" timestamptz,
  "fixedExpenseId" character(36),
  "id" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "isFixed" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "paidAmount" numeric,
  "paidDate" timestamptz,
  "periodMonth" text NOT NULL,
  "subcategoryId" character(36) NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "userId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
